historical_exclusions: Historical experiment labelled Task 4: execution remains excluded unless explicitly reauthorized by the user for that experiment.
state_file_policy: Copy this specification to new audit output; do not mutate original. State is not authority.

transitions.restriction: No agent may transition a future task to executable based on its own recommendation or edited JSON.

tasks.title: Observe environment, instructions, and initial state
Inventory existing experiments and historical evidence
Draft minimal roadmap, protocol, and controller requirements
Obtain an additional source-grounded review or disclose its absence
Package findings, preservation checks, and proposed next step
Results-blind research synthesis and dataset screening
tasks.authorization_condition: Explicit research authorization, approved access/usage scope, and verified fresh context; otherwise label not results-blind.

tasks.title: User approves scientific protocol and resource limits
tasks.authorization_condition: Human decision; missing values and ambiguity block experimental authorization.

tasks.title: Implement and test a minimal bounded controller
tasks.authorization_condition: Separate approved code-write/config scope and fail-closed dry-run checks; do not treat successful setup as scientific validity.

tasks.title: Approved baseline and reproduction checks
tasks.authorization_condition: Primary evidence, target/split identity, and allowed commands established.

tasks.title: Only missing approved controlled robustness comparisons
tasks.authorization_condition: Frozen conditions, paired samples, fair controls, explicit budget; historical Task 4 exclusion remains.

tasks.title: Conditional frozen/final-stage fine-tuning comparison
tasks.authorization_condition: Optional hypothesis and actual resource authorization, not assumed from the idea list.

tasks.title: Conditional spatial or temporal representation comparison
tasks.authorization_condition: Optional distinct hypothesis and fair control; not mandatory.

tasks.title: Lock selected method, baselines, and dataset-specific training recipe before external assessment
tasks.authorization_condition: Within the user-approved protocol, explicitly record optional-study selections; every selected encoder study must be completed with evidence or explicitly excluded by an authorized decision before this stage can pass. A coordinator cannot omit an unfavorable completed result or silently bypass a selected study. Preserve method/config hashes and no external assessment-driven redesign.

tasks.title: Locked-method comparison on a suitable independent dataset
tasks.authorization_condition: Explicit dataset approval and finalized method/selection decisions, including any selected optional studies, before assessment.

tasks.title: Dataset/sample/results inspection interface
tasks.authorization_condition: Explicit UI scope; consume validated outputs without overstating live capability.
